zones.title: Receive and acknowledge
zones.body: Only realtime.call.incoming is handled; everything else is acknowledged and ignored. The 200 goes out before any work.

zones.title: Session start
zones.body: The UUI comes out of the INVITE headers (User-to-User, hex). AR-01 starts the n8n session as the gateway would; a failed start rejects the call with 486.

zones.title: Accept
zones.body: The accept body carries the greeting, the session id, the proof prompt and the MCP tool server on n8n. The sideband sidecar (scripts/ar-sideband.mjs) is told the call id and sends the greeting response.create; a sidecar that is down does not block the store. The call id is stored on the session for the REFER.

panels.title: AR-51 OpenAI call incoming
panels.body: Accept within two seconds: the 200 goes first, then AR-01 and the accept. The prompt is a short proof prompt, not the AR-02 turn prompt. Webhook signature (Standard Webhooks HMAC) is not verified on the lab: a forged call id fails at the accept.
